_comment: Placeholder markets in the house voice. Celia owns this content. 'micro' markets close closesInMinutes after a reset; 'future' markets close at closesAt (ISO date). 'autopilot' templates are drawn at random when the booth runs unattended; probability is the chance the outcome is YES.

markets.question: The next talk title in this session contains "LLM".
markets.sourceNote: Resolved by the operator from the printed program.

markets.question: The first audience question in the next talk is more of a comment.
markets.sourceNote: Resolved by the operator, who was in the room.

markets.question: The plenary mentions the volume of AI-assisted submissions.
markets.sourceNote: Resolved by the operator after the plenary.

markets.question: The current paper session runs more than five minutes over.
markets.sourceNote: Resolved by the operator, using a clock.

markets.question: A speaker in the next session shows a QR code that nobody scans in time.
markets.sourceNote: Resolved by the operator's judgment, which is final.

markets.question: Someone in the next session says "can you hear me in the back?"
The next talk ends on a "Future Work" slide with more bullets than the "Findings" slide.
The operator sees a badge with four or more ribbons before lunch.
markets.sourceNote: Resolved by the operator. Ribbons are self-reported by lanyards.
